fullContentHtml:
UP SCVTUP ITI First Allotment Result 2026 - Complete Details

Short Information : State Council for Vocational Training, UP has released the first allotment result for the Government and Private College ITI Admission 2026. Applications for the UPTET Online Form 2026 were accepted from 11 July 2026 to 07 August 2026. Candidates who had applied this form can download their UP SCVTUP ITI First Allotment Result 2026 from the link given below..

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 11 July 2026
  • Last Date : 07 August 2026 (Extended)
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 04 August 2026
  • Merit List Issued : 27 August 2026
  • Counseling Begin : As per Schedule

Application Fee

  • General, EWS, OBC : Rs. 300/-
  • SC, ST : Rs. 250/-
  • All Female : Rs. 100/-
  • Pay the Examination Fee Through Debit Card, Credit Card, Net Banking, E Challan, E Wallet, Cash Card Fee Mode Only.
